data.one_liner: Obsolete package for sqlite3 version 2.x, update to version 3.x instead
data.what_it_does: This package is not used anymore and has been deprecated. Starting from version 0.7.0, all code has been removed to prevent apps from using older Flutter-specific SQLite build scripts.
use_when: You are migrating code or require old Flutter-specific scripts are no longer used after upgrading to version 3.x of sqlite3
avoid_when: You are starting a new project
You are using package:sqlite3 version 3.x or higher
strengths: Helps enforce that obsolete build scripts are removed during upgrades
weaknesses: The package is obsolete and no longer does anything
data.setup_notes: Remove this package from your dependencies after adopting version 3.x of package:sqlite3.

alternatives.name: sqlite3
alternatives.why_pick_it: Version 3.x of sqlite3 replaces the need for this package.
